'''Glazed terracotta''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds [[Mud Kiln]] recipes for the 16 variants below, and otherwise leaves them as in vanilla. See {{MCW|Glazed Terracotta}} for everything else.
